name: ClamAV
description: ClamAV is an open-source antivirus engine for detecting trojans, viruses, malware and other malicious threats. It runs as a local scanning daemon with automatic signature updates and can scan files, archives and mailboxes.

app_vars.name: var_scan_dir
app_vars.label: Scan Folder
app_vars.help: Absolute path inside the container that the daily scan checks; bind-mount host folders here

notes.text: Bind-mount the folders to scan to the scan folder (default /mnt/scan): pct set <CTID> -mp0 /path,mp=/mnt/scan,ro=1. A daily timer scans it and logs to /var/log/clamav/scan.log.
In an unprivileged container, only files readable by others on the host can be scanned. Use a privileged container to scan everything.
Infected files are only reported, not moved or deleted. On-access scanning is not available inside an LXC.
